added: Remote-voice meter: the pill on the second screen now follows the linked device's voice in real time via tiny loudness frames over the link.
A dedicated /changelog page (this one), driven by changelog.json — the same file that feeds the header version seal.
Self-hosted fonts and animation library: the app loads with zero third-party requests.
Always-revalidate cache headers, so browsers can no longer serve stale app files (the blank QR box and phantom line-number errors).
Push now lands in both places on the receiving device: the transcript editor and the clipboard tray.
changed: Voice pill rebuilt: dB-mapped, log-spaced frequency bands with fast attack and slow release; silence shows a faint breathing floor instead of a fake wave.
The top-bar remote-dictation zone is permanently reserved and fades in with opacity, so the bar never reflows while words stream.
Dictation accuracy extras for quiet voices: voice-activity threshold, voice focus, and microphone auto-gain are configured per session.
fixed: The last dictated sentence no longer waits for the next one before syncing to the linked device (the stream's end-of-turn signal is now honored).
Hindi and other languages no longer bleed into English dictation (sessions are pinned to English via language_codes).
The manual join input accepts exactly 6 characters, matching the room-code format.
Refreshing the page no longer drops the link session; the room is restored automatically for 12 hours.
Idle connections stay alive with a 25-second heartbeat and recover with jittered backoff and tap-to-retry.
The tail of audio left under one batch is flushed when recording stops, so final words are no longer clipped.

added: Second AssemblyAI account key support: tokens are routed by the selected speech model.
changed: Link Mode state is visible in the top bar and can be left explicitly.
Security headers (CSP, frame, referrer, permissions policies) are enabled site-wide.
fixed: The Link Mode QR code renders reliably; the QR library is vendored locally.
Link pairing completes through the hello handshake even when sends queue at fetch time.

added: Link Mode: pair devices with a 6-character room code or QR and relay live dictation and clipboard between them.
SyncRoom Durable Object: room relay with snapshot catch-up for late joiners, hibernation-safe state, and a 12-hour room lifetime.
A same-origin /api/link/ws proxy so browsers connect to relay rooms without cross-origin sockets.
fixed: PCM batching no longer duplicates tail samples between batches.

added: Local draft resilience: the transcript survives accidental reloads.
changed: Resilient hybrid visualizer engine fusing live microphone data with synthetic harmonics.
Vāk & Nāda layout polish: side pillars, custom SVG theme icons, gold scrollbars, and a mid-rail toast slot.
